description: This file defines a utility enum 'SimpleTaskSupport' that provides static functions to manage asynchronous tasks, including starting, stopping, and running a detached loop of asynchronous operations.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts an asynchronous task if not already running, executing the provided operation.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cancels and clears the specified task.

methods.name: startDetachedLoop
methods.description: Starts a detached asynchronous loop that executes the provided operation at specified intervals until cancelled.
